title: MZ Has Galv's character animations plugin been depricated?

posts.author: BeanmanBowen
posts.body: I tried using Galv's character animations to add a run and idle animation to the characters in my game however when i attempt to move, the character will move 1 frame and then movement will be permanently locked. I've gone through a bunch of tests including turning off every other plugin but this bug still persists, Am i missing some important feature or does it simply not work anymore, and if so is there an alternative?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
it is much more likely that you configured the plugin or your sprites in the wrong way.
can you post screenshots of your configuration?

posts.author: BeanmanBowen
posts.body:

have you checked with the plugin command if the plugin may be off and needs to be turned on inside the game (not in the plugin manager)?

posts.author: BeanmanBowen
posts.body:
For anyone else experiencing this issue that doesnt mind spending some money.
This plugin:
https://chaucer.itch.io/character-motions
